Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer compiled incomparable metrics—annualized returns for VGT (22.47%) and MGK (18.22%) versus a total return for VONG (419.5%)—and instructed comparing them directly. This apples-to-oranges comparison led to the incorrect conclusion that VONG had the highest percentage increase. The data should have been normalized (e.g., total returns for all three or annualized for all with conversion to cumulative) before determining the highest increase.
